_: Every tunable of the platform, in one place. Nothing in platform/ or tools/ carries its own default; it reads this file through coursekit.settings. Per-machine overrides go in .env or the environment (see .env.example), or in a JSON overlay named by SETTINGS_FILE. The `page` block, plus the bridge address, the providers a browser may call and the model list, reach the browser as CFG.platform. `providers` says how a model is reached and `models.list` says which ones there are, each naming its provider; the older `anthropic.*` and `claude.*` blocks are still read and moved to their new homes, so an existing .env or overlay keeps working.

providers._: How a model is reached. `kind` picks the adapter in coursekit/llm/: `cli` runs a headless binary, the rest speak a wire format. `apiProvider` on a `cli` row names the provider whose API serves the same models: a browser cannot spawn a process, so that is how a course page opened off disk reaches a model whose provider is a local tool. `openai` is Chat Completions and therefore also Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, OpenRouter, Groq and Azure - point `apiUrl` at one and set `maxTokensField` to the name that server takes. A provider with `enabled: false` keeps its configuration but is offered nowhere. A key is a secret: it is masked on the settings page and never reaches a course page.

claude-code.label: Claude Code
claude-code.signinHint: Run `claude` once in a terminal, sign in, and try again.

models._: Every model on offer. `provider` names the row in `providers` that reaches it; left out, it means `llm.defaultProvider`. `alias` is the short name a person types and is unique across the whole list; `id` need only be unique within its provider.

llm._: How hard the platform tries, whoever is answering. These are the retry policy and the budgets in coursekit/llm/chain.py, not any provider's own.
